name: Hotel Shri Vighnahar and Lodging
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor-listed pure-veg sit-down in Junnar named after Vighneshwar (the Ozar temple deity, 8km away). Family kitchen serving Maharashtrian thali for Astavinayak pilgrims; modak available daily (steamed). The post-darshan lunch stop on the Lenyadri-Ozar leg.
insider_tip: Lunch buffet/thali (₹250-300) at 12-2pm hits the Astavinayak tour-bus rush — eat at 11:30am or 2:30pm. Open 7am-10pm. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Junnar town, near Ozar Vighneshwar temple, Pune district 410502

name: Samadhaan Pure Veg
area: Junnar, base for Ozar Vighneshwar temple
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor 4.7/5 — 'lovely homestyle Maharashtrian food' in Junnar, the natural base for Ozar Vighneshwar temple (12km). Pure-veg, homestyle preparation distinct from highway dhaba menus. Useful for travellers doing the Astavinayak Pune-north leg (Ozar + Lenyadri together).
insider_tip: Pithla bhakri (₹200) is the under-the-radar order — Maharashtrian village comfort food. Aamras seasonal April-June (Hapus alphonso from the Konkan side). Cash + UPI.
